title: A hidden Ohmic bath generates unimodular vacuum energy
assumptions: Flat FLRW unimodular gravity with bath Hamiltonian independent of the reduced geometric variables.
Harmonic bath in unimodular time dt=a^3 d tau, Ohmic continuum/local limit and scalar mass renormalization.
Illustrative massless scalar p=rho, small diffusion coupling, initially vanishing effective Lambda and sufficiently cold initial bath.
Lambda is geometric (mass squared), rho_Lambda=Lambda/(8piG); m_p=G^(-1/2) is the unreduced Planck mass.
The printed Eq.(29) uses energy-density terms for deltaLambda and a half-sized dissipation integral, conflicting with Eqs.(28),(31),(33). No corrected Hamiltonian normalization is silently adopted.
predictions: In the noise-neglected illustrative branch, energy transfer generates a monotonic positive Lambda approaching a constant.
The magnitude depends on diffusion strength and onset conditions; a realistic observed-dark-energy prediction and perturbation closure are not supplied.
Eq.(38) and the first-order Eq.(39)-(40) are mutually consistent as a conditional deterministic system, but their claimed derivation from the printed Eq.(29) remains blocked.
